apply_edits.doc: Apply replacements serially; matching edits stay saved on disk even if another item fails and rejects. A single edit is an array of one.

old_string.description: Exact file text to find. Must match exactly one place.

new_string.description: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete old_string.

edits.description: Replacements applied serially; later items on the same path see earlier successful writes.

pattern.description: Glob relative to path, or to the workspace root when path is omitted.

paths.description: Matching paths, sorted by depth, then parent directory, then name.

pattern.description: Regular expression over file contents, unless literal is true.

before.description: Lines of context before each hit. 0-10.

after.description: Lines of context after each hit. 0-10.

glob.description: One glob or comma-separated globs. A leading ! excludes. Relative to path.

literal.description: Search for pattern as plain text.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the workspace.

text.description: Matching line text, capped at 500 characters.

read.doc: Read lines from one file or archived session transcript.

path.description: Prefer a workspace-relative path. Past session transcripts are readable at .litecode/sessions/<session_id>.md.

lines.description: Lines for this page, in file order.

content.description: Content to write to the file.

path.description: Workspace-relative path inside the workspace; requested path outside it.

code_search.doc: Semantic search over the workspace code index.

include_pattern.description: Optional glob filter for workspace paths.

min_score.description: Minimum raw dense cosine similarity for dense-only hits. 0–1. Lexical hits are not subject to this floor; 0 disables it.

start_line.description: First line in the returned snippet.

end_line.description: Last line in the returned snippet.

symbol.description: Optional AST symbol enclosing the anchor.

via.description: Which retrieval leg(s) admitted this chunk.

dense_similarity.description: Raw dense cosine similarity; 0.0 means the hit is lexical-only.

text.description: The anchor line itself, cheap enough for a table cell.

snippet.description: Source excerpt, at most 24 lines; overlong lines are capped.

hits.description: Empty if the search completed but found no matching chunks.

query.description: What to find in past session transcripts. Literal words or a phrase.

session_id.description: Optional session scope: full id, unique prefix, or the handle from a result.

own_session.description: Search only this session's transcript: the turns already folded out of the live context window. Cannot be combined with session_id.

session.description: Shortest unique session handle, also accepted by `session_id`.

bot_name.description: Derived bot name for this session, if any. Never a stored session field.

age.description: Relative age of the session's last update.

line.description: 1-based rendered transcript line of the hit.

via.description: Evidence that found this row, in rank order: `exact`, `prox`, `lex`, `sem`, `fuzzy`, joined by `+`.

hits.description: Flat rank order; not grouped by session.

total.description: Total matching rows before `limit` is applied.

truncated.description: True when `total` exceeds the returned rows.

semantic.description: False when the semantic leg was unavailable: the hits are lexical only.

exec_command.doc: Start a command. Waits up to yield_time_ms; a live session_id leaves it running in the background. Poll with write_stdin for output, or leave it and wait for the background-exit reminder (exit code + output_file).

workdir.description: Working directory; defaults to the turn cwd and must stay inside it.

tty.description: True allocates a PTY; false or omitted uses plain pipes.

yield_time_ms.description: Initial wait only; 250-600000 ms; default 600000. It does not limit the process lifetime.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token budget for this call; defaults to 1 MiB in run_code or 10000 tokens otherwise.

session_id.description: Live session id; null once the session has exited.

anyOf.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

exit_code.description: Process exit code once the session has exited; null while it is live.

output.description: Output since the previous call on this session; the first call returns output since spawn.

output_file.description: Workspace-relative path to the complete `.litecode/run/<job>.stdout` log (always full output on disk).

write_stdin.doc: Poll, feed, or interrupt an existing exec session. Empty chars waits until the session exits or yield_time_ms expires, returning accumulated output; on exit, exit_code is set and session_id is null.

chars.description: Bytes to write; empty polls. "\u0003" sends SIGINT to the process group.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding. Both modes accept 250-600000 ms; empty polls default 5000, non-empty writes default 250. Waiting inside a call pauses the run_code JS timer; one run_code call still has a 1800000 ms wall-clock cap.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token budget for this call; defaults to 1 MiB in run_code or 10000 tokens otherwise.

session_id.description: Live session id; null once the session has exited.

anyOf.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

exit_code.description: Process exit code once the session has exited; null while it is live.

output.description: Output since the previous call on this session; the first call returns output since spawn.

output_file.description: Workspace-relative path to the complete `.litecode/run/<job>.stdout` log (always full output on disk).

url.description: URL to fetch. Only http(s) URLs are accepted.

body.description: Empty for a non-2xx answer: the status carries the fact.

status.description: HTTP status of the final response, 2xx or not.

snippet.description: Query-relevant excerpt from the page, as returned by the provider.

results.description: At most top_k hits, best first; empty when the search found nothing.

browser_click.doc: Click one interactive element on the visible page.

ref.description: Element reference from the latest browser_read.

page_id.description: Optional page id. Omit for the active visible tab.

memory.delete.doc: Delete entries by id from the current session's working memory.

detail.description: Which limit the reason names, and by how much this item misses it.

todo.write.doc: Replace the current session task list; clearing occurs automatically when all items are completed.

total.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

pending.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

total.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.

incoming_count.description: Whole JSON number. The host rejects fractional values.
